title: Sandy Toes Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sandy Toes is the combination of Seabiscuit, the main front cottage, and Grace Sea, the rear guest cottage. Sandy Toes is conveniently located near the Westside Pool and a short walk to the beach.
description_expanded: MAIN HOUSE: sleeps 10GUEST COTTAGE: sleeps 2A Classic Seaside Compound Near the Beach & West Side PoolWelcome to Sandy Toes, a beloved Seaside beach retreat that combines two charming homes - Seabiscuit, the spacious main residence, and Grace Sea, a cozy rear guest home—into one exceptional vacation compound. Ideally located just a 3-minute walk to the beach and moments from the Westside Pool, this recently updated property is known for its incredible outdoor living spaces and relaxed coastal charm. With more than 1,250 square feet of covered, screened-in porch space, Sandy Toes feels like a true outdoor oasis designed for gathering, unwinding, and soaking in the Seaside lifestyle.Seabiscuit: A Charleston-Style Main Home with Expansive PorchesSeabiscuit is a classic Charleston-style home that comfortably sleeps up to 10 guests across three bedrooms. Designed in a modified “dog trot” layout, the home emphasizes indoor-outdoor living with first-floor bedrooms opening directly onto the shaded porches. Two levels of outdoor space feature a dining table for eight, rocking chairs, a cozy sleeping bench, and a built-in stereo—perfect for slow mornings and breezy evenings.On the first floor, a rear king bedroom offers a dresser, flat-screen TV, and a renovated ensuite bath with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and single vanity. At the front of the home, the second bedroom includes custom bunks with three twin beds and one double, sleeping four, along with a dresser and flat-screen TV. A nearby hall bath features a single vanity and tub/shower combination. Tucked into the hallway, a built-in twin bunk nook adds sleeping for two, each with its own mounted flat-screen TV.Upper-Level Living, Kitchen & Primary Suite RetreatUpstairs, the home opens to the main living spaces, including the kitchen, dining area, and living room. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a large double-door refrigerator with ice and water dispenser, and a breakfast bar with seating for three. Nearby, the dining table comfortably seats six to eight guests, while the living room offers a large sectional and additional seating—ideal for movie nights and family gatherings.The primary king suite on this level serves as a private retreat, complete with a flat-screen TV, large dresser, and a renovated ensuite bathroom featuring a single vanity, ample storage, and a spacious glass-enclosed shower with dual shower heads. Step onto the furnished screened porch off the bedroom to enjoy custom bench seating and club chairs—an inviting spot for a nightcap or quiet downtime. A spiral staircase leads to an open-air deck with panoramic views of Seaside and unforgettable sunsets.Grace Sea: A Private Guest Cottage EscapeTucked just behind the main home, Grace Sea offers a serene guest home experience with its own screened-in front porch. Inside, the living and dining area includes a built-in stereo, TV, and DVD player, creating a comfortable space to relax. The kitchen features granite countertops, a tiled backsplash, and a breakfast bar for casual meals. The king bedroom includes a private bath and flat-screen TV, while a second screened-in porch with rocking chairs and ceiling fan provides another peaceful outdoor retreat. Guests of Grace Sea also enjoy access to a private rear charcoal grill, perfect for laid-back cookouts.The Ultimate Seaside Getaway for Families & GroupsWith its unmatched combination of indoor comfort, expansive porches, multiple living spaces, and walkable access to the beach and amenities, Sandy Toes is an ideal Seaside vacation rental for families or groups traveling together. From sunrise coffee on the porch to sunset views from the deck, this coastal compound invites you to slow down, spread out, and experience Seaside at its very best.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break & Summer; Fall 3 nights; Winter 2 nights. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,863 square feet3-minute walk, 176 yards to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach at Pensacola Pavilion — the largest private beach on 30AMultiple outdoor dining spacesTwo outdoor charcoal grillsEnclosed outdoor showerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts, and a fitness center (court fees apply)Tower with Seaside rooftop views and breathtaking sunsetsWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (golf carts are considered vehicles; non-homeowner golf carts are prohibited; special circumstances or medical needs require a permit)No pets allowed
